desc: Prove the equivalence between repeated adjacent removals and noncrossing pairings, including which elements may remain when \(N\) is odd.
Derive the maximum-score formula for even \(N\), and determine how the formula changes for odd \(N\).
Find an \(O(N)\) or \(O(N \log N)\) implementation strategy and justify its correctness.
Test the derived method on the samples, all-equal arrays, monotone arrays, and small arrays where exhaustive pairing can validate the result.
Produce the final Python program that reads stdin, computes the maximum, and prints the answer.
